title: Flashcards: Where it is official, Oceania
intro: Flip each card about Oceania. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: In which country is Bislama an official language?
cards.explain: Bislama is an official language of Vanuatu.

cards.front: In which country is Fijian an official language?
cards.explain: Fijian is an official language of Fiji.

cards.front: In which country is Hiri Motu an official language?

cards.front: In which country is Palauan an official language?

cards.front: In which country is Tonga (Tonga Islands) an official language?
